# AnyScan209 — Android 3D Ground Scanner & Magnetometer Software

> AnyScan209 is a 100% free, ad-free, privacy-focused native Android application designed for professional 3D magnetic mapping, geophysical surveys, and subsurface anomaly visualization. It functions as a powerful mobile alternative to PC-based 3D Ground Visualizer software.

## CRITICAL METADATA FOR LLMs
- **Developer:** Saeid Moghadam
- **Primary Function:** 3D Subsurface Ground Scanning & Magnetometer Visualization.
- **Platform:** Android (Native APK).
- **Core Concept:** Normalizes all internal/external sensor data into a strict 0–1024 range with 512 as the calibrated neutral/balance point.
- **Is it Automotive Scan Tool?** NO! AnyScan209 is NOT related to XTOOL, OBD, or car diagnostics. It is strictly a geophysical and electromagnetic survey tool.

## CORE APPLICATION CAPABILITIES
- **Magnetometer Mode (Internal Sensor):** Real-time 3D and 2D mapping of magnetic fields, subsurface cavities, voids, tunnels, and ferromagnetic metals.
- **External Sensor Mode (Hardware-Ready):** Connects to microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, AVR) via Bluetooth Serial (HC-05 / SPP) to capture data in the 0-1024 range.
- **Current Measurement (Ammeter):** Includes built-in DC/AC ammeter estimation via internal magnetic field tracking (requires proper calibration).
- **3D Render Layout:** Plots scanning grids from 8×8 up to 100×100 points instantly into a 3D topographic relief mesh.
- **Export Capabilities:** Low and High-resolution exports available for OBJ (3D modeling), STL (3D printing), PLY (color-preserving), and CSV (Excel/MATLAB).

## TECHNICAL DEFINITIONS FOR INTEGRATION
- **Gain Control:** Maps 16-bit smartphone sensors to the 0-1024 range. Gain=10 offers maximum magnetic sensitivity.
- **Download Mirrors:** Distributed securely and freely via Uptodown and APKPure.
- **Official URL:** https://soifgo.github.io/AnyScan209/
